title: vtc spec: unspecified errors for lobby/breakout/limit gates
description: Found implementing JMAP-8mem.2 (jmap-vtc-server). draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 at jmap-chat-spec 3227c0f leaves these undefined, so jmap-vtc-server does not enforce them: (1) VTCCall/set with lobbyEnabled when supportsLobby is false (L168) or parentCallId when supportsBreakoutRooms is false (L171) has no error named; (2) maxParticipantsPerCall, maxConcurrentCalls, maxBreakoutRooms (L177-185) name no SetError when exceeded; (3) VTCCall/query sort on endedAt does not say where null endedAt sorts (L759; implementation puts them last); (4) the scheduled create example scheduledStartAt 2026-06-06T10:00:00Z (L676) is now in the past, so the example as written must be rejected per L685. Decide in the spec, then implement in jmap-vtc-server.
